profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at HERE Technologies
profile.summary:
Senior Principal Software Engineer with a master’s degree in computer science and a strong track record of developing and delivering quality software since 1998.

Before 2014, built a wide range of Client/Server, Stand-alone/Desktop, Web, and Mobile applications for diverse clients in the public and private sectors in Campeche, Mexico. Designed and implemented end-to-end solutions for HR departments (payroll, timeclock), business process management, data warehousing, and monitoring for businesses such as convenience stores, bars, and janitorial service companies.

Since 2014, thriving at HERE Technologies in the U.S. (currently a U.S. Permanent Resident), working remotely and cross-functionally with expert teams across our full mapping technology stack. Focused on empowering organizations to create interactive, high-precision maps of their private sites — including locations not represented on public maps — and enriching them with proprietary data, business logic, and sensor inputs to support advanced use cases like custom routing, asset tracking, and assisted driving.

A passionate problem solver and analytical thinker, with a strong ability to navigate complex and unpredictable system and user requirements. Known for quickly adapting to new tools, applying a variety of development methodologies, and collaborating across disciplines to deliver impactful solutions.

Technical highlights include extensive experience and solid working knowledge of Java, Kotlin, Scala, C++, JavaScript, and Python. Skilled in mobile development for iOS (Xcode), Android (Android Studio), and Tizen (Tizen Studio), with expertise in mobile architectures, concurrency models, IPC, AIDL, background processing, networking, and structured data storage. Strong backend development experience, including designing and implementing secure, scalable, and robust APIs using Dropwizard and other frameworks, with cloud proficiency in Amazon Web Services. Adept in CI/CD automation and deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitLab, and Linux shell environments. Well-versed in big data processing with Scala and Apache Spark, particularly for building and validating complex geospatial data pipelines at scale.

Certified by SANS served as a Security Guardian and Champion for the HERE Platform Experience tribe, with a strong focus on secure coding practices, threat awareness, and proactive collaboration to ensure platform-wide security and resilience.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Thrilled to step into my new role, delivering the next generation of private mapmaking! I collaborate across expert teams and our full mapping technology stack to validate and integrate HERE map data into customer-contributed content — enabling organizations to build rich, interactive, and highly customized private maps. These maps incorporate proprietary features like private roads, trails, ports, warehouses, farms, and other off-the-grid sites not covered by public maps.

This work empowers customers to create high-precision, site-specific maps tailored to their operational needs — and to enrich them with their own data, business logic, and sensor inputs. Whether it’s enabling smarter routing, better navigation, enhanced asset tracking, or real-time visibility for field teams, we give organizations the tools to map their world, their way.

Leveraging our advanced services in map rendering, geocoding, search, and navigation, my team is focus on delivering a reliable, scalable, and secure solution — from data ingestion to integration, validation, and deployment.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal software engineer and technical lead of a project that delivers custom solutions for HERE customers. The solution uses HERE's core technology stack, such as HERE map content, HERE location libraries, HERE data processing libraries, HERE pipelines running Scala code in Spark, and HERE routing. The year after being promoted to principal, worked as the lead backend engineer of the HERE Marketplace, version 2.0. Architected its backend, a microservice solution implemented in Kotlin, using Ktor.io, and workflow orchestration with Temporal.io. SANS certified security guardian and champion for the HERE Platform Experience tribe.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to the HERE Platform and HERE Marketplace success as the Marketplace Service Lead Software Engineer in Seattle.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Engaged in architecture and system design, product specification, and user and graphical specifications. Engaged in Java, Objective C, and JavaScript development, serving as key member of Seattle's office team to build HERE's client SDKs for Android, iOS, and Tizen platforms. Worked with backend teams to build HERE's Predictive Data Analytics solutions that work with Cloud services. Utilized Agile software development and Scrum methodologies. Researched and understood  smartphone technologies, limitations, and platform specific differences. Performed test automations as well as engaged in test driven software development. Developed  end-to-end integration test applications to verify the right data flow in HERE technologies pipeline and frameworks. Coordinated and updated domain expertise documentation for HERE’s internal and external customers. Troubleshot and resolved production issues with customers. Reviewed the work of the professional team members while ensured quality and accuracy of assigned tasks. Mentored, trained and assisted other engineers in area of expertise.

positions.title: Computer Systems Analyst
positions.description: Gravity Solutions is a contractor in providing IT solutions. Worked for them training their staff in Android Development, from 02/01/2014 to 04/30/2014. Placed as Android Developer contractor at HERE North America LLC in Cambridge, MA office, from 05/04/2014 to 10/15/2014. As contractor at HERE Cambridge, engaged in architecture and system design, product specification, and user and graphical specifications. Engaged in Android development, serving as key member of Cambridge's office team to finish the Here Maps application for Android released in August 2014. Worked with backend teams to build the Here Maps UI's that work with Cloud services and HERE Restful API's. Utilized Agile software development and Scrum methodologies. Researched and understood smartphone technologies, limitations, and platform specific differences.

positions.title: Computer Systems Engineering Professor
positions.description: Taught Computer Systems Engineering and Computer Science courses, such as Programming Fundamentals, Data Structures, Object Oriented Programming, Advanced Topics in Programming, Databases, and Mobile Programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Served a diverse client base in the public and private sectors in Campeche, Mexico. Roles included software design and development, business analysis, program and project management. Applied a broad range of current technologies, and a variety of methodologies. For all applications I designed the project’s path and engineered the user interfaces design for the mobile and web. Used Balsamiq Mockups for all UIs. Used the MVC pattern to divide the application in Presentation layer, Domain Layer/Service Layer and Data Source Layer. Designed the database model in MySQL. Designed the web services to communicate with client application by using RESTful web services, and JSON Parsing for the received responses. Worked in different programming languages, IDEs, and SDKs, such as Java/Eclipse, ObjectiveC/iOS/Xcode, and Java/Android/Android Studio. Implemented Bluetooth and Location Connectivity components. Implemented Google Maps API v2 with forward and reverse geo-location. Extended and implemented open-source QR scanning code. Used jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS for client front-end. Used Linux shell, Git, Maven, and Jenkins for continuous integration.

positions.title: Academic Coordinator/CS Professor/Software Engineer
positions.description: Organized, managed, and monitored projects and activities at the Computer Science and English departments. Taught programming and computer science courses for Information Systems Engineering, such as Computer Algorithms, C++, Java, SQL, Databases, E-Commerce, and Android. Project lead and developed the production of quality software for the Institute and its partners, such as a Time-clock solution for controlling personnel attendance through biometrics. The solution’s name is SCADA (Sistema para el Control de Docentes y Administrativos), which has been distributed to other UNID campuses around Mexico, such as Cancun, Guadalajara, Aguascalientes and Cd. Del Carmen. SCADA facilitated human resources department to track tardiness and absences of all employees, administrative staff and faculty. SCADA can also manage class replenishment for professors who couldn’t make it to teach on a limited number of times per month. SCADA has a real-time messaging system that sends notifications to the Dean, Academic Coordinators, and Human Resources, every time a tardiness or absence has been registered in the system. SCADA produces helpful reports in iReports that are used by the Human Resources department in its Payroll system.
